plugin_name: Microsoft SQL Server Remote Code Execution via Malformed Query
description: SQL Server Analysis Services component improperly handles a malformed query, permitting remote code execution.
solution: Apply vendor cumulative update or upgrade to SQL Server 2017+.

plugin_name: PostgreSQL Privilege Escalation via ALTER ... DEPENDS ON EXTENSION
